name: Korenovsk-Dinskaya Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced pipeline length; also no sponsor named and no concrete step beyond inclusion in the federal territorial-planning scheme (Government Order 816-r, Annex 4 item 359)
researcher_notes: Annex 4 item 359 of Russian Government Order 816-r (sudact.ru, verified name+0.2555 bcm/y) lists 'Реконструкция газопровода Кореновск-Динская' in Krasnodar urban okrug, Dinskoy district (Dinskoe, Plastunovskoe) and Korenovsky district (Korenovskoe, Platnirovskoe), design volume 0.2555 bcm/y, purpose: supply to prospective consumers of Krasnodar, Korenovsk and Dinskaya districts. A planning-scheme reconstruction item, i.e. a local distribution/branch line, not a trunk. Not in GGIT snapshot 20260930 (no Korenovsk/Dinskaya string in any row); P1470/P5551 are Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov I/II (1177 km), unrelated segment names, so matched_existing not asserted. No sponsor, length, diameter or construction step found in searches (Russian web search; Gazprom Southern Corridor PDF mentions only a 57 km KS Kubanskaya-KS Korenovskaya jumper, 700 mm, which is a different facility and not cited). Likely well under or near the 25 km threshold, unsourced -> monitor on length. Route not researched.
